arxiv-2108-12683.title: Background for the Self Consistent Renormalisation (SCR) Theory
arxiv-2108-12683.creator: Bharathiganesh Devanarayanan, Akariti Sharma, Alpesh Sheth, Prafulla K. Jha, Navinder Singh
arxiv-2108-12683.description: Abstract A detailed review is given on the evolution of the theory of itinerant magnetism. The self-consistent renormalization (SCR) theory is quite successful in addressing the phenomenon of itinerant magnetism in weakly and nearly ferromagnetic and anti-ferromagnetic materials [ 1 ] . It goes beyond the Stoner and random phase approximation (RPA) theories in taking the correlation effects into account.

arxiv-2205-08699.title: Suppressing classical noise in the accelerated geometric phase gate by optimized dynamical decoupling
arxiv-2205-08699.creator: Da-tong Chen, Jun Jing
arxiv-2205-08699.description: Abstract In the quantum-computation scenario, the geometric phase-gates are becoming increasingly attractive for their intrinsic fault tolerance to disturbance. With an adiabatic cyclic evolution, Berry phase appears to realize a geometric transformation. Performing the quantum gates as many as possible within the timescale of coherence, however, remains an inconvenient bottleneck due to the systematic errors.

arxiv-2406-16169.title: On the origin of polar planets around single stars 2024 On the origin of polar planets around single stars – References
arxiv-2406-16169.creator: Cheng Chen, Stanley A. Baronett, C. J. Nixon, Rebecca G. Martin
arxiv-2406-16169.description: Abstract The Rossiter-McLaughlin effect measures the misalignment between a planet’s orbital plane and its host star’s rotation plane. Around 10 % \% of planets exhibit misalignments in the approximate range 80 − 125 ∘ 80-125^{\circ} , with their origin remaining a mystery.

arxiv-2411-06076.title: BreakGPT: Leveraging Large Language Models for Predicting Asset Price Surges
arxiv-2411-06076.creator: Aleksandr Simonyan
arxiv-2411-06076.description: Abstract This paper introduces BreakGPT, a novel large language model (LLM) architecture adapted specifically for time series forecasting and the prediction of sharp upward movements in asset prices. By leveraging both the capabilities of LLMs and Transformer-based models, this study evaluates BreakGPT and other Transformer-based models for their ability to address the unique challenges posed by highly volatile financial markets.

arxiv-2505-06005.title: Second Price Matching with Complete Allocation and Degree Constraints
arxiv-2505-06005.creator: Rom Pinchasi, Neta Singer, Lukas Vogl, Jiaye Wei
arxiv-2505-06005.description: Abstract We study the Second Price Matching problem, introduced by Azar, Birnbaum, Karlin, and Nguyen in 2009. In this problem, a bipartite graph (bidders and goods) is given, and the profit of a matching is the number of matches containing a second unmatched bidder.

arxiv-2506-18276.title: Modulator-Assisted Local Control of Quantum Battery via Zeno Effect
arxiv-2506-18276.creator: Songbo Xie, Manas Sajjan, Ashok Ajoy, Sabre Kais
arxiv-2506-18276.description: Abstract Quantum batteries are devices designed to store and deliver energy using quantum mechanics. In charger-mediated protocols, energy is transferred from a charger to batteries via their interaction, typically modulated through quenches that require either global or local access to the primary systems.

arxiv-2506-21203.description: Abstract . The study of the evolving phenomena in a domain helps to understand the relationships between entities at different points in time and predict future trends. These phenomena, often complex, can be represented using knowledge graphs, which have the capability to model heterogeneous data from multiple sources.

arxiv-2509-15971.title: LeakageDetector 2.0: Analyzing Data Leakage in Jupyter-Driven Machine Learning Pipelines
arxiv-2509-15971.creator: Owen Truong 1 , Terrence Zhang 1 , Arnav Marchareddy 1 , Ryan Lee 1 , Jeffery Busold 1 , Michael Socas 1 , Eman Abdullah AlOmar 1
arxiv-2509-15971.description: Abstract In software development environments, code quality is crucial. This study aims to assist Machine Learning (ML) engineers in enhancing their code by identifying and correcting Data Leakage issues within their models. Data Leakage occurs when information from the test dataset is inadvertently included in the training data when preparing a data science model, resulting in misleading performance evaluations.

arxiv-2511-05920.title: IoT-based Fresh Produce Supply Chain Under Uncertainty: An Adaptive Optimization Framework
arxiv-2511-05920.creator: Chirag Seth, Mehrdad Pirnia, James H. Bookbinder
arxiv-2511-05920.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chirag Seth, Mehrdad Pirnia, James H. Bookbinder. Fruits and vegetables form a vital component of the global economy; however, their distribution poses complex logistical challenges due to high perishability, supply fluctuations, strict quality and safety standards, and environmental sensitivity. In this paper, we propose an adaptive optimization model that accounts for delays, travel time, and associated temperature changes impacting produce shelf life, and compare it against traditional approaches such as Robust Optimization, Distributionally Robust Optimization, and Stochastic Programming.

britannica-1911-game.title: Game (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-game.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-game.description: Article 'Game' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. means any amusement or sport, often combined in the early examples with “glee,” “play,” “joy” or “solace.” It is a common Teutonic word, in O. gaman, but only appears in modern usage outside English in Dan. The ulterior derivation is obscure, but philologists have identified it with the Goth.

pmc-10623536.title: XBP1 promotes NRASG12D pre‐B acute lymphoblastic leukaemia through IL‐7 receptor signalling and provides a therapeutic vulnerability for oncogenic RAS
pmc-10623536.creator: Azam Salimi, Mirle Schemionek‐Reinders, Michael Huber, Margherita Vieri, John B Patterson, Julia Alten, Tim H Brümmendorf, Behzad Kharabi Masouleh, Iris Appelmann
pmc-10623536.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Activating point mutations of the RAS gene act as driver mutations for a subset of precursor‐B cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemias (pre‐B ALL) and represent an ambitious target for therapeutic approaches. The X box‐binding protein 1 (XBP1), a key regulator of the unfolded protein response (UPR), is critical for pre‐B ALL cell survival, and high expression of XBP1 confers poor prognosis in ALL patients. However, the mechanism of XBP1 activation has not yet been elucidated in RAS mutated pre‐B ALL.

pmc-11544078.title: Strontium isotope and trajectory method elucidating overseas migration of Mythimna separata to Japan
pmc-11544078.creator: Naoya Hidaka, Caihong Tian, Shengnan Zhang, Gaku Akiduki, Guoping Li, Ichiro Tayasu, Ki-Cheol Shin, Tokumitsu Niiyama, Gao Hu, Shimin Li, Akira Otuka, Hongqiang Feng
pmc-11544078.description: SummaryThe oriental armyworm, Mythimna separata, generally migrates from eastern to northeastern China in early summer, and some individuals are believed to migrate overseas to Japan depending on meteorological conditions. This potential migration was investigated with the immigrants’ strontium radiogenic isotope ratio 87Sr/86Sr and backward flight trajectories from Japanese trapping sites.

pmc-11625900.creator: Rinchu Loomba, Nandita Maini Jindal
pmc-11625900.description: PurposeThe traditional method of oral examination, though a good tool for assessing the depth and breadth of student’s knowledge, has its shortcomings. A variable number of questions with variable difficulty levels by different examiners with different expectations can introduce bias in scores.

pmc-11715863.title: Large‐scale validation of an improved and resource‐saving immunoprecipitation‐mass spectrometry assay for plasma amyloid‐β biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease
pmc-11715863.creator: Yijun Chen, Xuemei Zeng, Marcos Olvera‐Rojas, Anuradha Sehrawat, Tara K Lafferty, William E Klunk, Milos D Ikonomovic, Tharick Ali Pascoal, Kirk I Erickson, Victor L Villemagne, Ann D Cohen, Nathan Yates, Irene Esteban‐Cornejo, Oscar L Lopez, Beth E Snitz, Sarah Berman, Robert Sweet, Thomas K Karika
pmc-11715863.description: BackgroundAmyloid β (Aβ) deposition in the brain is a pathological hallmark of Alzheimer's disease (AD). While immunoprecipitation‐mass spectrometry (IP‐MS) stands out as an accurate method for quantifying blood‐based Aβ peptides, its major limitations such as prolonged sample preparation, extensive analysis time, large specimen volume, and high costs, present opportunities for improvement.

pmc-11969354.title: Anteromedial Tibial Tubercle Osteotomy for Recurrent Patella Subluxation
pmc-11969354.creator: Carlos E. Franciozi, Victor A. Barcelos, Enzo S. Mameri, Felipe C. Schumacher, Marcos V. Credidio, Marcelo S. Kubota, Marcus V. Luzo
pmc-11969354.description: Background:Patellofemoral pathology resulting from improper biomechanics is difficult to treat, and lateral patellar instability requires individualized treatment, which may include tibial tubercle osteotomy (TTO) with anteromedial repositioning.Indications:Symptomatic patellofemoral instability with maltracking, particularly in cases with a tibial tuberosity-trochlear groove distance >16 mm.Technique Description:We describe an oblique osteotomy from medial to lateral.

pmc-12515255.title: Influence of Glutathione S-transferase Mu 1 (GSTM1), Glutathione S-transferase Theta 1 (GSTT1), and N-acetyltransferase 2 (NAT2) Variants on Bladder Cancer Progression and Recurrence Rating: A Bosnian and Herzegovinian Case-Control Study
pmc-12515255.creator: Osman Hadziosmanovic, Benjamin Kulovac, Amina Valjevac, Almir Fajkić, Izabela Uzar, Grazyna Adler
pmc-12515255.description: Introduction: It is suggested that bladder cancer (BC) development is linked to glutathione S-transferase (GST) enzymes. This study aimed to determine the correlation between glutathione S-transferase Mu 1 (GSTM1), glutathione S-transferase Theta 1 (GSTT1), and N-acetyltransferase 2 (NAT2) variants with BC progression and recurrence rating.

pmc-12523306.title: From Heart to Abdominal Aorta: Integrating Multi-Modal Cardiac Imaging Derived Haemodynamic Biomarkers for Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Risk Stratification, Surveillance, Pre-Operative Assessment and Therapeutic Decision-Making
pmc-12523306.creator: Rafic Ramses, Obiekezie Agu, Hisao Hara
pmc-12523306.description: Recent advances in cardiovascular imaging have revolutionized the assessment and management of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) through the integration of sophisticated haemodynamic biomarkers. This comprehensive review evaluates the clinical utility and mechanistic significance of multiple biomarkers in AAA pathogenesis, progression, and treatment outcomes.

pmc-12540770.title: Fragility analyses and strong ground motion response of mechanically stabilized earth retaining walls with plate anchors
pmc-12540770.creator: Marzie Ansari Targhi, Mohammad Safi, Ali Noorzad
pmc-12540770.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Reliable and cost-effective design of mechanically stabilized earth (MSE) walls in earthquake-prone regions remains a fundamental challenge in geotechnical engineering. The present study evaluates the seismic performance and failure levels of MSE walls. To this end, the influence of ground motion frequency content with different amplitudes on wall response has been investigated to compute the displacements, and to develop fragility curves based on multiple intensity measures.

pmc-12642702.title: Growth and rupture of pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm following hormonal stimulation for in vitro fertilization: a case report
pmc-12642702.creator: Italo Simões, Estela Regina Ramos Figueira, Ralph Rodrigo Francisco Martins Tavares, Camila Garcia Marchiolli, José Jukemura
pmc-12642702.description: Mucinous cystic neoplasms (MCNs) of the pancreas are rare mucin-producing epithelial tumors that predominantly affect middle-aged women and typically contain ovarian-type stroma responsive to hormonal stimulation. While progression and rupture of MCNs during pregnancy have been documented, the effects of exogenous hormonal stimulation remain uncertain.
